product_name: 水电大坝低空安全防护
summary: A C-UAS operation for hydroelectric dams, reservoirs, powerhouses, spillways, and inspection routes. Based on critical infrastructure protection requirements, it focuses on low-altitude awareness, target identification, location, tracking, warning linkage, and dispatch coordination for complex terrain, water reflection, and fog-prone dam environments.
summary_en: A C-UAS operation for hydroelectric dams, reservoirs, powerhouses, spillways, and inspection routes. Based on critical infrastructure protection requirements, it focuses on low-altitude awareness, target identification, location, tracking, warning linkage, and dispatch coordination for complex terrain, water reflection, and fog-prone dam environments.
summary_ru: Процесс низковысотной безопасности для гидроэлектрических плотин, водохранилищ, машинных залов, водосбросов и инспекционных маршрутов. Он основан на логике защиты критической инфраструктуры и охватывает наблюдение, подтверждение цели, сопровождение, согласование тревог и разбор событий в сложном рельефе, при бликах воды и тумане.
key_application: 水电大坝、库区岸线、厂房周界、溢洪道、取水口、闸口、巡检道路、输变电接口和运行调度值守场景。
key_application_en: Hydroelectric dams, reservoir shorelines, powerhouse perimeters, spillways, intake areas, gates, inspection roads, grid-interface zones, and operations duty rooms.
key_application_ru: Гидроэлектрические плотины, берега водохранилищ, периметры машинных залов, водосбросы, водозаборы, ворота, инспекционные дороги, узлы подключения к энергосети и дежурные диспетчерские.
key_parameter_1_en: Operating Chain: low-altitude detection, target identification, location, continuous tracking, warning linkage, and dispatch coordination.
key_parameter_1_ru: Цепочка процесса: обнаружение низковысотной аномалии, подтверждение цели, непрерывное сопровождение, уведомление о риске и замкнутый разбор события.
key_parameter_2: 环境适配：结合可视化画面、热成像辅助与人工复核，降低水面反光、雾气、鸟类活动和复杂地形带来的影响。
key_parameter_2_en: Dam-Environment Adaptation: visual review, thermal assistance, and operator confirmation help reduce the impact of water reflection, fog, bird activity, and complex terrain.
key_parameter_2_ru: Адаптация к среде плотины: визуальная проверка, тепловизионная поддержка и подтверждение оператором помогают снизить влияние бликов воды, тумана, птиц и сложного рельефа.

industry_pain_points: Dam bodies, powerhouses, spillways, intake areas, and grid-interface zones operate continuously, so abnormal low-altitude activity nearby can disrupt duty-room judgment and operational order.
Reservoir valleys, water reflection, fog, rain, and bird activity make single-camera observation or manual patrols prone to missed events, false alarms, and delayed confirmation.
Long shorelines, access roads, gates, and inspection routes require operators to see when a target appears, where it moves, which risk area it approaches, and how the alert status changes.

Dam low-altitude security needs awareness, confirmation, tracking, alert circulation, and dispatch coordination in one process so abnormal target information does not remain fragmented between duty roles.
uav_industry_upgrade: Discover: maintain low-altitude awareness around the dam body, powerhouse, reservoir bank, gates, and inspection routes to surface abnormal target clues early.
Confirm: use visual review, thermal assistance, and operator verification to identify the target context while filtering reflection, birds, and terrain noise.
Track: record movement direction, approach area, dwell position, and related zones so the duty team can follow target changes.
Link: route alerts by risk area and synchronize target imagery, tracks, and alert status to support operations dispatch and field patrol coordination.
parameters_en.solution_modules_intro: The solution is organized around a concise low-altitude security chain: discover abnormal activity, confirm the target, track movement, and link alerts with operations dispatch and field patrol roles. It focuses on duty-room process, data synchronization, and dispatch coordination.

industry_pain_points: Тело плотины, машинный зал, водосбросы, водозаборы и узлы подключения к энергосети работают непрерывно, поэтому низковысотная активность рядом с ними влияет на дежурную оценку и порядок эксплуатации.
Горный рельеф водохранилища, отражение от воды, туман, осадки и птицы усложняют наблюдение: одного видеоканала или ручного обхода часто недостаточно.
Протяженные берега, подъездные дороги, посты и инспекционные маршруты требуют единой картины: где появился объект, куда он движется, к какой зоне приближается и как меняется статус события.

detail_html_en:
Industry Pain Points

  • Dam bodies, powerhouses, spillways, intake areas, and grid-interface zones operate continuously, so abnormal low-altitude activity nearby can disrupt duty-room judgment and operational order.
  • Reservoir valleys, water reflection, fog, rain, and bird activity make single-camera observation or manual patrols prone to missed events, false alarms, and delayed confirmation.
  • Long shorelines, access roads, gates, and inspection routes require operators to see when a target appears, where it moves, which risk area it approaches, and how the alert status changes.
  • Dam low-altitude security needs awareness, confirmation, tracking, alert circulation, and dispatch coordination in one process so abnormal target information does not remain fragmented between duty roles.

Operational Flow

  • Discover: maintain low-altitude awareness around the dam body, powerhouse, reservoir bank, gates, and inspection routes to surface abnormal target clues early.
  • Confirm: use visual review, thermal assistance, and operator verification to identify the target context while filtering reflection, birds, and terrain noise.
  • Track: record movement direction, approach area, dwell position, and related zones so the duty team can follow target changes.
  • Link: route alerts by risk area and synchronize target imagery, tracks, and alert status to support operations dispatch and field patrol coordination.
